**Summary:**

The internet originated in the 1960s with US Department of Defense funding for ARPANET, which demonstrated its first message in 1969 and transitioned to TCP/IP protocols in 1983. Tim Berners-Lee's invention of the World Wide Web in 1989, followed by the Mosaic browser in 1993, made the internet accessible to ordinary users. The dot-com boom of the late 1990s led to a crash in 2001, but survivors like Amazon and Google became highly valuable companies, while social media and mobile internet (accelerated by the 2007 iPhone launch) further transformed global communication. Today, over 5 billion people are connected, and the internet underpins virtually every aspect of modern life.
